candidates.title: [Performance]: Cross-NUMA API tokenization increases TTFT on DeepSeek-V4-Pro with Ray
candidates.snippet: We reproduced a TTFT slowdown on DeepSeek-V4-Pro with Ray. The vLLM API tokenizer first touched memory on one NUMA node, then processed subsequent requests on another. The extra tokenizer latency caused refill requests to miss a scheduling window. In a controlled run, changing only the first tokenizer call’s NUMA placement reproduced the slowdown while prefill step time stayed stable. candidates.title: [Feature]: DFlash2 best-first tree verification for Qwen3.5/GDN on Model Runner V2
candidates.snippet: ### 🚀 The feature, motivation and pitch  Add an opt-in **DFlash2 best-first tree verifier for Qwen3.5 / Gated DeltaNet (GDN) on Model Runner V2**, starting with greedy decoding and a fixed 16-node budget.  The current DFlash2 path consumes one chain from the predecessor-conditioned candidate scores. A miss stops that chain even when another candidate at the same position would match the target. candidates.title: 0.40.18 regression (Windows, ROCm): json_schema requests fail mid-load with "Unexpected empty grammar stack after accepting piece: @ (31)" and return HTTP 200 with an empty body
candidates.snippet: ### What is the issue?  After the automatic update from 0.40.17 to 0.40.18, requests with a JSON schema start failing partway through a model load with  ``` got exception: Unexpected empty grammar stack after accepting piece: @ (31) ```  Ollama answers these requests with **HTTP 200 and an empty body**, so the client sees no error, only an empty string where JSON should be. Once it starts, every request of the same kind fails until the model is unloaded and loaded again. Rolling back to 0.40.17
